scoring_rule: UNKNOWN/NO_DATA cells are never scored as zero; they abstain and propagate as unknowns into sensitivity. Any hard invariant failure excludes a design regardless of weighted score.

designs.name: Minimal promote/challenge gate
designs.mechanics: Fixed 5-state machine (contract §9). Promotion iff provisional threshold holds: >=2 verified evidence, >=2 independence groups, same claim version/scope, no unresolved challenge/revocation, provenance/digest/policy present, governance-only final step. Challenge moves PROMOTED->CHALLENGED immediately with view exclusion; re-promotion needs a new decision.
designs.state_space: 5 states x 8 events; threshold is a closed checklist.
designs.authority: worker proposes; governance_gate decides; operator resolves/escalates.
designs.cost_model: operator_actions_per_case ~ challenge_rate x resolution_steps; backlog = open challenges older than SLA hypothesis.

designs.name: Argumentation model
designs.mechanics: Claims with attack/support relations; acceptability via grounded-style semantics: a claim is IN iff it has >=1 accepted supporter and every attacker is OUT; an attacker is OUT iff it has an accepted counter-attacker or is itself defeated by evidence. Supporters/attackers are evidence-backed arguments with provenance. Cycles default to OUT (fail closed).
designs.state_space: Claim graph + IN/OUT/UNDECIDED labels; semantics computed by fixed-point iteration with a step cap; UNDECIDED after cap means non-promotion.
designs.authority: worker proposes arguments; governance_gate computes semantics and admits only IN claims; operator resolves UNDECIDED clusters.
designs.cost_model: operator_actions_per_case ~ undecided_clusters + attack_graph_review_steps; backlog = UNDECIDED claims awaiting operator structuring.

designs.name: Truth-maintenance model
designs.mechanics: Beliefs with justifications (IN/OUT support lists). A belief is IN iff at least one justification holds (all IN-nodes IN, all OUT-nodes OUT) and no contradiction node is IN. Source revocation flips the source node OUT, propagating downstream automatically (belief revision). Contradictions trigger dependency-directed backtracking to the assumption set.
designs.state_space: Belief network + justification records; propagation is monotonic except revision steps which are versioned and audited.
designs.authority: worker asserts with justifications; TMS propagates automatically; governance_gate admits only IN beliefs; operator resolves contradictions.
designs.cost_model: operator_actions_per_case ~ contradiction_events x backtracking_steps; backlog = unresolved contradiction sets.
